Armadillo.headline: My Tush Hurts drops 202 and somebody's tush definitely hurts
paragraphs: Argrider opened the season by putting 202.82 on kbartelt07 and winning by 84.46, the biggest score in all of APFN. Kenneth Walker went for 34.1, Justin Jefferson for 31.2 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba for 26.2. The scary part: Argrider started Harold Fannin for 4.1 and left Isaiah Likely's 26.8 on the bench, and still cleared 200. Remember that tight end decision. It comes back.

kbartelt07 got 32.7 from Christian Watson and not a lot else. The team is named Burrow my Cook in Nabors, and Joe Burrow and Malik Nabers delivered 15.16 and 12.9. George Kittle added 3.2, which is the kind of number you usually see on a kicker who missed the bus.
Burrow my Cook in Nabors got buried instead.

Juravieal survived lowkeyeastt 139.66 to 135.76, a 3.9-point escape built on 32.6 from Jahmyr Gibbs. The Phyrexian Dreadnoughts got 7.0 from the kicker and 3.0 from the Broncos defense and still got away with it, which says more about the other lineup than this one.

Because here is the other lineup. Wide Receivers' Galore started Courtland Sutton for 3.1 and Colston Loveland for a clean zero, while Jakobi Meyers sat on the bench with 12.2. lowkeyeastt left 14.2 points unused and lost by 3.9. D'Andre Swift (32.4), Jonathan Taylor (24.1) and Lamar Jackson (23.96) did their jobs. The coaching did not.
Lost by 3.9 with 14.2 on the bench. Galore of excuses.

YukonMike hung 185.76 on xovsa0989 and won by 77.54. Josh Allen scored 34.66, Jalen Coker 33.8 and DJ Moore 21.0. The two worst starters were Travis Kelce at 10.1 and the kicker at 10.0, which is a nice problem to have.

Waddlin to london started Jaylen Waddle and got 1.2 out of him, then started Drake Maye for 12.82 while Jaxson Dart (25.6) and Brock Purdy (22.1) watched from the bench. xovsa0989 left 18.8 on the pine. Bijan Robinson's 29.3 was the only adult in the room.
Waddlin' to london? Waddle got 1.2. Nobody's going anywhere.

queens22 beat Thomasg2488 156.30 to 104.14 with David Montgomery (28.9), Chris Olave (28.2) and Trey McBride (24.5). Not perfect, either: Kyle Pitts scored 0.0 in the lineup and Trevor Lawrence's 26.1 sat on the bench. Did not matter.

Thomasg2488 got 28.7 from Amon-Ra St. Brown and left Patrick Mahomes and his 22.66 on the bench, part of 20.2 points unused. Losing by 52.16 means none of it would have saved the day, but it would have made the scoreline less embarrassing to look at.
Thomasg2488 benched Mahomes. Let that sink in.
Rowdy0991 put up 186.54 against cartercole and won by 55.18, with Derrick Henry at 35.3, Ashton Jeanty at 32.7 and Dallas Goedert at 23.7. A tidy, violent afternoon.
cartercole got 37.26 from Caleb Williams, and then Ja'Marr Chase put up 3.2. Tate Dogg and Warren T came out of the gate with one guy rapping and the other one forgetting the words.
Tate Dogg and Warren T: one verse, no hook.

Grizzly.headline: 57.7 points on the bench, and the Grizzly opener writes itself
paragraphs: adamgum beat vpettijohnjr 133.94 to 101.16 behind David Montgomery (28.9), Amon-Ra St. Brown (28.7) and Javonte Williams (24.2). A solid, boring, grown-up win.

The story is the other bench. Medicaid's Most Wanted left 57.7 points unused, the most in APFN this week, with Jalen Coker's 33.8 and DJ Moore's 21.0 sitting down while Ja'Marr Chase (3.2) and Jaylen Waddle (1.2) started. vpettijohnjr lost by 32.78. The right lineup wins this game going away. The wrong lineup got started.
57.7 on the bench. That's not a bench, that's a second team.
seachicken22 beat chookonthecoast 149.62 to 127.56 with Kenneth Walker (34.1), Jalen Hurts (24.72) and Jonathan Taylor (24.1). Colston Loveland's zero in the lineup did not matter.

Certified Coke Head got 34.66 from Josh Allen and 29.3 from Bijan Robinson, then started George Kittle (3.2) and TreVeyon Henderson (0.0) while Chuba Hubbard (23.7) and Patrick Mahomes (22.66) sat on the bench. chookonthecoast left 23.7 points unused and lost by 22.06. The right lineup wins by a hair. Moving fast, skipping steps.
Lost by 22.06 with 23.7 on the bench. Certified self-inflicted.

Dfiasco0 beat kingruddofrock 166.90 to 116.12 on Derrick Henry (35.3), Jahmyr Gibbs (32.6) and Jaxson Dart (25.6). Little Giants were not perfect: Harold Fannin scored 4.1 and Drake London 5.5 in the lineup, and Trevor Lawrence's 26.1 sat on the bench. Won by 50.78 anyway.
kingruddofrock got 31.2 from Justin Jefferson, then Kyle Pitts posted a zero and the kicker added 2.0. Maye I See Dem TD's? Not this week.
Little Giants played like big ones. Maye I See Dem TD's saw none.
thatguyPegleg beat Ghaztyz 141.36 to 77.66, with Caleb Williams at 37.26 and D'Andre Swift at 32.4. Ghaztyz's 77.66 was the lowest score in APFN this week.

Kraftin' Lamars is named after two players. Lamar Jackson scored 23.96 and Tucker Kraft 9.5, and those were the first and third-best players on the team. Jordan Addison scored 0.0, the Texans defense scored -1.0, and Deebo Samuel (18.0) and Jayden Daniels (17.66) sat on the bench. Ghaztyz left 26.0 unused and lost by 63.7.
Kraftin' Lamars crafted 77.66. Arts and crafts, kindergarten level.

ArmedRodgery21 beat IronMike1987 181.60 to 127.86 with Christian Watson (32.7), Chris Olave (28.2) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (26.2), and left Isaiah Likely's 26.8 on the bench without it costing a thing. IronMike1987 got 32.7 from Ashton Jeanty, 15.4 from CeeDee Lamb and a 3.0 from the Broncos defense.
IronMike1987 brought a knife to an Armed robbery.

Robber.headline: Five robberies before the paint is dry
paragraphs: ArmedRodgery21 beat adamgum 201.46 to 116.60, the biggest margin of the week at 84.86, behind Josh Allen (35.66), Christian Watson (32.7) and Zay Flowers (26.0). Then came the fun part. Jahmyr Gibbs scored 33.6 for Reaper25 in the loss, so ArmedRodgery21 stole Jahmyr Gibbs.
Reaper25 did the work and someone else collected the harvest.

Dfiasco0 beat Juravieal 132.66 to 129.26, by 3.4. The Collectible Cardigans got 37.26 from Caleb Williams, 32.4 from D'Andre Swift and 31.3 from Bijan Robinson, and lost anyway, because Brock Bowers scored 0.0 and the Texans defense scored -1.0. No bench in this league, so there was nothing to swap in. Hide Your Players then took Bijan Robinson, which is advice Juravieal should have read first.
Hide Your Players. Juravieal didn't. Bye, Bijan.

thatguyPegleg beat vpettijohnjr 173.30 to 133.26 with Derrick Henry (35.3), David Montgomery (28.9) and Chris Olave (28.2). Kenneth Walker put up 34.1 for Pukkake in the loss, so thatguyPegleg took Kenneth Walker. That one will age well.
Pukkake scored 133.26 and still got bent over for its best player.

queens22 beat kbartelt07 143.92 to 98.46 with Justin Jefferson (31.2) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (26.2), then took De'Von Achane, who scored 10.6 in the loss. Rashee's Lambo got 24.96 from Lamar Jackson and 3.2 from George Kittle, which is not enough to make the payments.
Rashee's Lambo: repossessed in week 1.
cartercole beat Ghaztyz 135.02 to 115.36 with Ashton Jeanty (32.7) and Jalen Hurts (24.72), then took Amon-Ra St. Brown, who scored 28.7 for LaPorta potty in the loss.
LaPorta potty got flushed, and somebody fished out Amon-Ra on the way down.
